input.description: Add crash sound on game over

part.text:
Added simple sound effects using the Web Audio API:

- **Thrust**: short 300 Hz square tone played on each click/touch.
- **Crash**: low‑pitch 80 Hz tone played when the ship collides or falls out of bounds.
- Integrated sound triggers into the existing input handler and game‑over routine. The gameplay and graphics remain unchanged, now with audio feedback.
